required_product_decision.recommended_form: Make c2_completion_mode_length a real optimizer-proof leaf (prefer the established non-LTO assembler-leaf pattern), call it at all four linked boundaries, and let the ELF-derived ABI and stateless-length gates prove the actual calls and retry edge.
required_product_decision.why_not_another_C_hint: The requested property is specifically independence from optimizer-chosen liveness. A noinline hint still negotiates with the optimizer; an assembler leaf removes that jurisdiction and has existing project precedent.
required_product_decision.next_after_authorization: Implement the leaf and its exact ABI/constant proof, run one fresh WPLTO, then only after every wall and gate is green build Link 64 and prepare the Cutpoint-3/4 hardware appointment.
